title: After-work and opportunity update
objective: Draft the checklist for executive-validation follow-up.
clearance: Rewritten draft; pending SME and partner clearance

blocks.x: Momentum depends on fast, accurate follow-up. Commitments that aren't written down tend to drift.
Glean's checklist asks for this within the same day to 24 hours after the meeting:

items: **A concise recap:** decisions, success criteria, the validation path, the timeline, and owners.
**Access** to the tailored demo or Glean Lab assets.
**Updated records:** the opportunity workbook and stage criteria, reflecting the executive confirmations.
**Business case and close plan:** built or refined.
**Sponsor cadence:** the executive sponsor, technical champion, and partner engagement steps logged, and upcoming checkpoints confirmed.
**Next validation:** if a pilot is needed, its scope, success metrics, and duration documented and kickoff scheduled. Otherwise, technical validation dates locked.

blocks.x: The recap should separate accepted commitments from open questions. Link only approved, customer-facing assets. Reconfirm access permissions for every shared artifact.

blocks.label: Boundary
blocks.x: Never send internal account judgments, scores, pricing policy, or private notes to the customer.
Send the recap within a day, and keep commitments separate from open questions.

blocks.title: After the readout
blocks.alt: A four-step after-work sequence within 24 hours: send a concise recap, update the opportunity records, refresh the business case and close plan, and set the sponsor cadence and next validation step.

items.label: Set the cadence
items.detail: Sponsor check-ins and the next validation
